summary: Precision Drilling Corporation filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing its 2026 second quarter unaudited financial results. The filing reports an 11% revenue increase to $453 million, a net loss of $1 million, and operational cash flow of $146 million used to reduce debt by $50 million and repurchase $12 million of common shares. There are no merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist, or other special-situation transactions disclosed. The routine quarterly earnings report does not trigger any special-situation classification under the defined categories.
